nodes.label: RISE: Reasoning Behavior Interpretability via Sparse Auto-Encoder
nodes.author: Zhenyu Zhang, Shujian Zhang, John Lambert, Wenxuan Zhou, Zhangyang Wang, Mingqing Chen, Andrew Hard, Rajiv Mathews, Lun Wang
nodes.rationale: Unsupervised framework discovering reasoning vectors via SAEs on step-level activations; enables controllable amplification/suppression of reflection, backtracking, and confidence behaviors

nodes.label: Sparse Auto-Encoder for Reasoning
nodes.rationale: Learns dictionary of sparse latent features reconstructing hidden states; decoder columns correspond to interpretable reasoning behaviors; Theorem 1 establishes recovery up to permutation and scaling

nodes.label: Reasoning Vectors: Disentangled Behavior Directions
nodes.rationale: Linear directions in activation space encoding distinct reasoning behaviors; reflection/backtracking occupy overlapping subspaces; confidence vectors concentrated in bottom-right SAE decoder region

nodes.label: Causal Intervention on SAE Vectors
nodes.rationale: Injecting SAE vectors during inference controllably modulates reasoning; negative intervention suppresses reflection/backtracking; positive intervention amplifies; generalization across domains (GPQA, KnowLogic)

nodes.label: Unsupervised Discovery of Confidence Behavior
nodes.rationale: Entropy minimization identifies confidence-related decoder columns; reduces reflection/backtracking steps; enables test-time steering improving accuracy +4.66 points with 13.69% token reduction

nodes.label: RISE uses sparse auto-encoders for behavior discovery
RISE applies causal interventions on reasoning vectors

hyperedges.label: Interpretability and Controllable Steering of LLM Behaviors
